description: Answer yes_no, choice and scale questions from rules you send, with a probability, a confidence and an action (act, review or hold) for each question. state holds the facts. A rule is {"if": condition, "weight": number}, where a condition tests a field of state with eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, exists, prefix or contains, combined with any and not. Nothing is stored. The full format is at https://aisense.no/free-public-api-decide-api-endpoint. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.
name: decide
title: Decide from rules
